messages.subject: MetDesk station forecasts issued - 06Z run, 16 Nov
messages.snippet: The 06Z run has replaced the 00Z station forecasts in the service (issued 06:44Z). Skelwith Edge remains on interim values while the AWS ane
messages.body: The 06Z run has replaced the 00Z station forecasts in the service (issued 06:44Z). Skelwith Edge remains on interim values while the AWS anemometer head is iced (INC0088412); we will reissue Skelwith Edge when the head clears. Arun Pellow, duty forecaster.

messages.body: Mild Atlantic air spreading in from midweek; light winds in the valleys. Routine runs at 00Z, 06Z and 12Z as usual; next outlook Sunday 22 Nov.

messages.subject: Fwd: anemometer head swap Skelwith Edge
messages.snippet: Field Instrumentation will swap the heated anemometer head at Skelwith Edge this week (CHG0047176). Until then MetDesk may reissue Skelwith
messages.body: Field Instrumentation will swap the heated anemometer head at Skelwith Edge this week (CHG0047176). Until then MetDesk may reissue Skelwith when icing clears.
